sources.content: LangGraph docs explain thread checkpoints, persistent state and durable resume; re-execution hazards require side-effect boundaries.
OpenAI agent evaluations discuss trace grading, datasets and graders for detecting workflow regressions.
Claude Code documentation distinguishes persistent instructions, rules, hooks and subagents and their authority/load patterns.
MCP authorization specification specifies OAuth protected resource metadata and token audience validation for HTTP transports.

proposals.candidate: Add durable side-effect fences and per-execution trace ids
proposals.mechanism: Combine thread-level state recovery with source-bound audit records
proposals.test_metric: Duplicate side effects per 100 crash/replay injections
proposals.falsifier: Any crash replay performs a consequential effect twice

proposals.candidate: Independent hook and reviewer isolation gates
proposals.mechanism: Distinguish model-selected reviewers from cryptographically validated actor identity
proposals.test_metric: Incorrect acceptances on 50 adversarial unauthorized tool invocations
proposals.falsifier: An unsigned reviewer/unauthorized hook grants execution

proposals.candidate: Bound per-request transport identity to accepted issuer/audience
proposals.mechanism: Enforce provider metadata and token resource binding
